source_text: In a non-binding recommendation, the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe adopted Resolution 1952 (2013) on "Children's right to physical integrity," asserting that non-therapeutic circumcision of boys for religious reasons violates the child's physical integrity and potentially Article 3 of the European Convention on Human Rights (prohibition of inhuman or degrading treatment). [97]
